title: Bookkeeper & Administrative Coordinator
description:
About the Role
Crossroads Staffing is looking for a highly organized, detail‐driven professional to join our team in a dual‐focused role that blends bookkeeping, logistics coordination, and administrative support. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‐paced industrial environment, enjoys variety in their day, and is confident managing both financial workflows and equipment movement across borders.

You will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records while ensuring our shipments, freight, and equipment logistics run smoothly and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
Bookkeeping & Financial Support
• Daily use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central to manage financial data (mandatory requirement)
• Prepare and issue invoices and proformas
• Complete bank and credit card reconciliations
• Support payroll, general ledger entries, and month‐end/year‐end processes
• Maintain accurate and organized financial documentation

Administrative Support
• Provide general administrative assistance to office and operations teams
• Assist with scheduling, internal reporting, and workflow coordination
• Support data tracking and daily operational processes

Qualifications
Required
• Proficiency with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (applications without this experience will not be considered)
• Experience in bookkeeping, accounting, or a senior administrative role
• Excellent organizational skills and ability to multitask under pressure
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Strong logistics or freight coordination experience (asset)

Preferred
• Experience in construction, equipment rental, or industrial sectors
• Experience with ERP systems or inventory tracking software
• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. shipping regulations

Compensation & Benefits
• Competitive hourly wage based on experience
• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
• RRSP matching program
• Opportunity to grow within a dynamic and expanding company

Bi-weekly pay: $25 to $35/hour (based on experience)
.
Hours of work are Monday to Friday 7:00 am to 4:00 pm. Bi-Weekly pay. Overtime after 44 hours.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
About the role
We are currently seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant for our client, a growing plumbing and heating company, to support daily operations. This position plays a key role in ensuring efficient coordination between the office, technicians, and customers.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys managing multiple priorities while keeping operations running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide general administrative support to the office team
  • Coordinate service scheduling and dispatch technicians accordingly
  • Communicate effectively with technicians and customers to ensure seamless daily operations
  • Maintain accurate records and perform data entry across systems
  • Work with ServiceTitan and other cloud-based platforms
  • Manage backflow documentation and related administrative tasks
  • Assist with invoicing, job tracking, and reporting
  • Organize files, documents, and internal processes
  • Handle inbound calls, emails, and customer inquiries professionally
  • Support additional administrative functions as required

Qualifications

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent communication and coordination abilities
  • Proficiency with computers and office software
  • Strong problem-solving skills and adaptability
  • Experience with dispatching is considered an asset
  • Experience with ServiceTitan or similar platforms is preferred
  • Comfortable working with numbers and data

Compensation & Schedule

  • $22–$25 per hour (based on experience)
  • Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Weekly pay
  • Overtime after 44 hours

title: Manufacturing Labourer - Afternoon Shift
description:
We are currently hiring Manufacturing Team Members for one of our local clients in Orillia. This opportunity is for the afternoon shift, with hours of work from Monday to Friday, 3:00 pm to 11:00 pm.

Pros to this position are:
  • Afternoon Shift, No early mornings
  • Full time hours and one steady shift
  • $1.50/hr shift premium
  • Weekly Pay, Overtime after 44 hours
  • Training provided

Duties Include:
  • Working on an assembly line in different departments
  • Making parts, cables, elements
  • Placing shorter pieces of metal into large machines stretching and lengthening it to make longer/thinner lengths of cable
  • Working with bigger machines
  • Winding lengths of finished cable on a big machine to wrap
  • Moving product to Carts
  • Testing and quality control
  • Maintaining timelines
  • Making products to set specifications
  • Keeping work area tidy and clean
  • Adhering to workplace health and safety

Requirements:
  • CSA approved steel toed boots
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs, standing, bending, twisting
  • Ability to use micrometers
  • Reliability/Good attendance
  • Ability to follow direction and a strong willingness to learn
  • Ability to read a tape measure
  • Previous manufacturing experience an asset
  • Must be available to train on day shift Mon-Fri 7am to 3pm for min 1 week
Weekly pay. Wage $19.00/hr plus $1.50/hr shift premium on all hours worked on afternoon shift.

title: Cemetery Lettering Technician
description:
Crossroads Staffing is recruiting a Cemetery Lettering Engraver for a long‑standing, family‑owned monument company in the Orillia area. This is a highly specialized and meaningful trade that plays an important role in honouring families and their loved ones.

In this role, you will engrave inscriptions on monuments that are already installed in cemeteries.  Cross‑training is also provided in the production shop, particularly in the layout department.

Key Responsibilities
  • Travel to cemeteries to complete on‑site monument engraving
  • Operate mobile compressors, sandblasting equipment, and specialized tools
  • Cut detailed stencils with precision and accuracy
  • Prepare, mask, and finish inscriptions on granite monuments
  • Maintain professionalism and respect in sensitive cemetery environments
  • Assist in the production shop or with other crews as required
What You Bring
  • Ability to work independently and stay organized
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Good fine motor skills and hand coordination (stencil cutting is a major component)
  • Mechanical aptitude (asset)
  • Comfortable working outdoors in all weather conditions
  • Willingness to work longer hours during peak seasons
  • Occasional overnight travel (company‑paid meals & accommodations)
  • Valid G driver’s licence + clean driving abstract
  • Ability to perform moderate physical labour, including lifting and working around heavy monuments and equipment
  • Professional, respectful conduct when working around families and cemetery staff
Why This Opportunity Stands Out
  • $26/hr to start
  • Benefit package after 3 months on employer payroll (50% employer‑paid)
  • All travel expenses covered for overnight stays
  • Long‑term, stable career in a specialized trade
  • Supportive, family‑oriented team with cross‑training opportunities
Hours & Pay
  • Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM – 4:30 PM
  • Bi‑weekly pay
  • Overtime after 44 hours
